name: Bethel Baptist Church
tagline: A Baptist church in Ashwell — one book at a time, since 1841

services.label: Morning service
services.note: Preaching, singing, and coffee before and after

services.label: Evening service
services.note: Smaller, quieter, more time for questions

services.label: Prayer meeting
services.note: In the church hall. Nobody is asked to pray aloud

_series_note: A chapel preaches through a book over months. Where the church currently is in it is real information for a visitor — arriving at week nine of Romans is walking into a conversation.

series.note: Sunday mornings until the spring. Chapters 1 to 8 are on the sermons page if you would like to catch up, though you do not need to.

_baptism_note: The signature of this template. Believer's baptism by immersion is what makes this tradition itself, and it is the question people circle for months without asking. The NEXT DATE is stated, because 'speak to one of the elders' is not an answer to somebody working up to it on their own.

baptism.when: In the morning service, with a shared lunch afterwards
baptism.note: We baptise three or four times a year. There is no minimum age and no maximum.
